label: country 编码连接基数
sql: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM raw.stats_store_performance_country) source_rows,(SELECT count(*) FROM raw.stats_store_performance_country p LEFT JOIN raw.google_play__country_codes c ON c.country_code_numeric=p.country_region) joined_rows,(SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT country_code_numeric FROM raw.google_play__country_codes GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)) duplicate_numeric_codes

label: 源键空值
sql: SELECT count(*) n,count(*) FILTER(WHERE date IS NULL) null_date,count(*) FILTER(WHERE package_name IS NULL) null_package,count(*) FILTER(WHERE country_region IS NULL) null_country FROM raw.stats_store_performance_country

label: email 边界样例
sql: SELECT count(*) n,count(*) FILTER(WHERE EMAIL LIKE '%..%') consecutive_dot_emails FROM raw.tiktok_advertiser_data
